description.content: Returns metric data for the specified metric path and time range. The rollup parameter controls whether data is aggregated into a single value or returned as individual data points. Supports wildcard characters in the metric-path parameter.

query.description: (Required) The full metric path to retrieve data for. Supports wildcard characters using the pipe delimiter for path levels.
(Required) The type of time range to use for the query.
Duration in minutes for BEFORE_NOW and BEFORE_TIME time range types.
Start time in Unix epoch milliseconds for AFTER_TIME and BETWEEN_TIMES time range types.
End time in Unix epoch milliseconds for BEFORE_TIME and BETWEEN_TIMES time range types.
When true, aggregates data into a single data point. When false, returns individual data points. Defaults to true.
The output format for the response. Defaults to XML if not specified.

item.name: List request snapshots for an application

description.content: Returns transaction request snapshots for the specified application and time range. Snapshots capture detailed information about individual request executions including call graphs, data collectors, and error details.

query.description: (Required) The type of time range for the snapshot query.
Duration in minutes for BEFORE_NOW and BEFORE_TIME time range types.
Start time in Unix epoch milliseconds.
End time in Unix epoch milliseconds.
Comma-separated list of snapshot GUIDs to retrieve specific snapshots.
When true, includes archived snapshots in the results.
Filter snapshots by the deep-dive policy that triggered them.
Comma-separated list of tier IDs to filter snapshots.
Comma-separated list of business transaction IDs to filter snapshots.
Filter by user experience classification.
When true, only returns the first snapshot in a cross-application call chain.
When true, includes data collector properties in the response.
When true, includes exit call details in the response.
Filter for snapshots with execution time greater than this value in milliseconds.
Filter by data collector name.
Filter by data collector type.
Filter by data collector value.
The output format for the response. Defaults to XML if not specified.

The AppDynamics Metric and Snapshot API allows developers to retrieve metric data and transaction snapshots from monitored applications. It supports configurable time ranges, data aggregation through rollup parameters, and access to various metric types including response times, error rates, and call volumes. Developers can retrieve request snapshots for detailed transaction analysis and configure metric retention periods to control how long performance data is stored.
